convert.description: One TypeScript Selenium file to Playwright: intake, recall, risk review, then up to three convert/validate/critic laps before the report. Inputs: source_path (required, a path on the server), context_paths, output_path, refinement, ask_risks, user_id, remember, max_attempts.

suite.description: A whole Selenium folder: scan it, convert every file in dependency waves (the convert graph as a subgraph, fanned out with Send), then compile the finished tree as one project and write the report. Inputs: root (required), out_root, only.
